title: Build daily todo list with passive-aggressive unchecking behavior

requirements.text: Create a clean daily todo list interface where users can add new tasks with a text input and submit button

quotes: build a clean daily todo list

acceptanceCriteria: Interface displays an input field for adding new tasks
Interface includes a button or enter key functionality to submit tasks
Visual design is clean and uncluttered

requirements.text: Display all todo items in a list with checkboxes, where each item shows the task text and can be toggled between checked and unchecked states

quotes: build a clean daily todo list

acceptanceCriteria: Each task displays with a checkbox
Tasks can be checked and unchecked by clicking the checkbox
List updates immediately when tasks are toggled

requirements.text: When a task is checked off, display it with normal styling (e.g., strikethrough or completed state)

quotes: if a check a task off it behaves normally

acceptanceCriteria: Checked tasks have visual indication of completion (such as strikethrough)
No special alerts or popups appear when checking a task

requirements.text: When a task is unchecked, immediately change the task text color to red

quotes: if i uncheck a task turn the text red

acceptanceCriteria: Unchecking a previously checked task changes its text to red
Red text persists until the task is checked again

requirements.text: When a task is unchecked, display a popup modal with a randomly generated passive-aggressive insult about the user's work ethic

quotes: make a popup with a randomly generated highly passive aggressive insult about my worht ethic

acceptanceCriteria: Popup appears immediately when a task is unchecked
Popup contains a passive-aggressive message related to work ethic
Message is randomly selected from a collection of different insults
Popup can be dismissed by the user

requirements.text: Store the list of todos and their checked/unchecked states in the backend so they persist across sessions
acceptanceCriteria: Todos are saved to the backend when added
Todo states (checked/unchecked) are persisted when toggled
Todos are retrieved from backend on page load

requirements.text: Apply a creative, coherent visual theme to the todo list interface with a distinct style including color palette, typography, and layout that is consistently enforced throughout
acceptanceCriteria: Interface uses a cohesive color scheme (excluding blue and purple unless contextually appropriate)
Typography choices are consistent and readable
Layout is clean and visually appealing with good spacing

constraints: Use only React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn components for the frontend
Backend must use Motoko with single-actor architecture
Do not modify immutable frontend paths including useInternetIdentity hooks and main.tsx
nonGoals: Multi-user todo lists or sharing functionality
